translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: HEBREO
book.title: Dos Sulat Atag to mgo HEBREO

content: Mid Ikahi kos Monama Keta Ukit to Anak Din no si Disas Krays
Na dangan no timpu, komo-uraa id posaddoo to Monama iddos ponudtulon din diyot keton kovuyyahan
ukit to mgo propeta, woy nokod-osso-ossa kos po-ukit to kodposaddoo rin tadda.

Piru inin morin mgo allow, id posaddoo idda to Monama keta ukit to Anak din. Woy ukit en kandin, id bovallan to Monama kos langun diyon to langit woy ka-ay't ingod, woy id aam sikandin to Monama no od pongomunoy to langun.
Diyot kandin, od kokita kos langun no se-aa to kotuusan woy kopiyannoy to Monama, oyyos waa ko-ossan din to Monama.

Sikandin kos id somad to langun no riyot langit woy ka-ay't ingod ukit to kotuusan to kahi rin. Nopongnga ki nikandin id linisan pomon diyot mgo saa ta, id livod sikandin diyot datas to langit woy mid unsad lomig to kowanan to Monama no Motuus to langun.
Lampas pa iddos Anak to Monama taddot mgo Ponolihan
Na pomon ka-ay, id pokita to Monama no lampas iddos Anak din taddot mgo ponolihan, su iddos ngaran no id boggoy kandin to Monama, lampas pa kos bantug taddot ngaran to mgo ponolihan.
Oyyos waa en ponolihan no id osengan to Monama no,

content.text: Inin allow, id pokilaa ku no Amoy a nikkow.”

content: Woy waa en mandad id oseng kos Monama moka-atag taddot ahad ondoy no ponolihan no mid ungketen to,
Na, diyot timpu no id popiyod don to Monama ka-ay to ampow't ingod iddos Anak din no ponganoy,

content.text: “Ko-ilangan no od simba kandin iddos langun no ponolihan.”

content: Woy ini en kos id oseng to Monama moka-atag to mgo ponolihan, kahi rin to,

content.text: “Sinuhuwan ku iddos mgo ponolihan, woy kopakoy nod bovallan ku sikandan iling to apuy woy kaamag no od tuman to suhu ku.”

content: Piru riyot Anak din, mid ikahi iddos Monama to,

content.text: “Sikkow en kos Monama. Od hari ka to waad tomanon, woy motallong kos kodhari ru to kikow'n mgo minuvu.
Id kahaa-i ru kos motallong no pinuungan,
piru id kolingasa-i ru kos kororattan.
Idda en kos unayan no siyak no Monama ru,
id aam ku sikkow nod boggayan to bantug woy kahaan no lampas pa taddot langun no duma ru.”

content: Duwon mandad id ikahi to Monama riyot Anak din no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Sikkow, od Longaggon, diyot tigkonayan, mid bovaa ka to ingod
woy ukit to bollad du, novovallan iddos langun no riyot langit.
Od kowora man kos langun, piru sikkow, od taman en to waad tomanon.
Langun ka-ay, iling to tapoy'n umpak no dii ron od kahamit.
Woy iling to tapoy'n umpak, od luppiyon du kos langit woy ingod, woy od buwassan du to lammi.
Piru sikkow, dii ka en od kopalin, woy dos umuu ru, od taman to waad tomanon.”

content: Na atag mandad taddot mgo ponolihan, waa en ahad sokkad kandan no id osengan to Monama iling ka-ay't id oseng din diyot Anak din, kahi rin to,

content.text: “Unsad ka lomig to kowanan ku, taman tod kotalu kud iddos od pongkuntra kikow woy id po-iraom ku sikandan to kikow'n kodponguu.”

content: Na, ko ungketen, iddos mgo ponolihan, mgo ispiritu sikandan no sinuhuwan to Monama amoy od tavang to langun nod kotobbus.

footnotes.text: Sikandan en kos kovuyyahan to mgo Hebreo no id ngoranan mandad no mgo Judio.
Od kovasa ini riyot Salmo 2:7; Pinuungan 13:33.
Od kovasa ini riyot 2 Samuel 7:14; 1 Cronicas 17:13.

Diyot botasanon to mgo Judio, iddos ponganoy no anak no mama kos od dokollan to koru-anon. De-en id ngoranan si Disas no ponganoy, oyyos sikandin kos lampas to langun no duwon koru-anon, woy id posivontuhan sikandin to Monama no Amoy rin.
